physicalDesign.authority: ONE_SHARED_SQLITE_CAS_FENCE_REGISTRY_DOCUMENT consulted by every T06d/Native-C privileged Claim writer; a per-Task registry or process singleton is not a substitute.
physicalDesign.atomicity: The complete active-lease registry is one CAS document. Acquisition compares the full frozen resource sets and atomically adds a lease with mustBeAbsent/mustMatchRevision; bounded CAS retry preserves disjoint concurrent acquisitions and rejects overlap.
physicalDesign.identity: Each lease binds repository, protectedClaimKey, issueRef, writerId, sourceSha, dispatchId, generation=1, exact frozen resource object and digest, fenceId, global fence revision and a random owner-nonce hash.
physicalDesign.continuousPossession: The nonce remains only in the Host process. Every privileged stage re-reads the shared registry and validates the same lease and resource identity before use. Other disjoint lease updates do not invalidate possession.
physicalDesign.lifetime: A lease has no time-based automatic takeover. Definite pre-effect denial may release the still-owned lease; successful publication and ambiguous/pending states retain it for Task ownership. Restart, stale nonce, fake Owner evidence and unknown registry state fail closed.
physicalDesign.publisherFence: Native C receives only the Host-owned fence port. It must assert the matching held lease before and after each external POST. Omitting the port or using a mismatched/stale/lost lease prevents the POST or preserves the pending reservation without retry.
physicalDesign.resourceCompatibility: The PR #371 readHeldFence implementation derives compatibility from current durable foreign leases and their exact frozen resource objects, never from caller booleans or projected claim fields. A foreign active Claim without a matching valid lease is incompatible.
frozenResources: Each exact source path in allowedWriteSet, represented as path:<repo-relative-path>.
The protected Claim key and its CAS reservation key.
The native GitHub Issue #370 comment effect.
The exact source SHA, Pack blob, review and Owner receipt identities bound in the frozen resource object.
physicalDesign.noGlobalLock: Disjoint Tasks may hold leases concurrently. Only real path/CAS/native-effect overlap or unknown authority serializes.
